summary: Regression testing of routes.py refactoring (split into auth_routes/worker_routes/admin_routes/booking_routes + route_utils) and the new SalonWorkers.jsx account management UI. All 12 existing RBAC pytest tests still pass. New regression test suite (19 tests) covers every endpoint group across all 4 sub-routers — all pass. Frontend UI verified end-to-end: SalonWorkers renders all 8 workers with account-status indicator, Marija shows green 'Nalog aktivan (worker@salon.com)' + 'Ukloni nalog', 7 other workers show 'Kreiraj nalog za prijavu'. Full create→display temp password→copy buttons→close→delete-account cleanup flow verified.
action_items: Prior-iteration bug still open: CalendarView.jsx worker prev-day boundary (selectedDate>today comparison uses timestamps not midnight). Not re-verified in this iteration — remains E1's fix from iter_36.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py is now a clean 15-line orchestrator including 4 sub-routers. All 4 sub-routers register their own APIRouter and are mounted with /api prefix at the parent level. Clean separation.
route_utils.py is properly shared: _get_tid, _generate_temp_password, _get_salon_today, PI_API_KEY/BASE, COUNTRY_TIMEZONES. No duplication observed across sub-modules.
SalonWorkers.jsx (~645 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold; consider extracting the Create-Account dialog and the Add/Edit Worker dialog into their own components to keep the file focused.

SalonWorkers.jsx fetchData() sequentially fires N+1 GET /workers/{id}/account requests (one per worker) — for larger tenants this could be replaced by a single bulk endpoint GET /workers/accounts. Acceptable at current scale (8 workers).

auth_routes.py PUT /auth/change-password still does NOT require current password verification (flagged in iter_36) — any authenticated user (admin/super/worker) can silently reset own password without re-auth. Security review recommended.
worker_routes.py create_worker_account correctly returns temp_password ONCE in body (must_change_password=true), and 409 on duplicate email/worker. Verified via API + UI.
admin_routes.py get_services (line 278-313) does raw JWT decode instead of using Depends(get_current_user) — inconsistent pattern; consider refactoring for uniformity, though functionally correct.
booking_routes.py get_reservations worker branch is timezone-safe (uses _get_salon_today) and correctly enforces the 7-day window + worker_id scoping (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (SalonWorkers UI checks and full create-account E2E flow both pass)

seed_data_creation: E2E test created and deleted a worker account (test_regr_{id}@salon.com) — full cleanup performed, no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 verified the routes.py -> 4-module refactor and the SalonWorkers.jsx account UI. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression_iter37.py hits every endpoint group (auth/worker/admin/booking) — 19/19 pass. Frontend: SalonWorkers shows account-status per worker card; Marija=active (green dot, Ukloni nalog), others=Kreiraj nalog link that opens a Dialog with email input, on success displays temp_password with Copy buttons for both email and password. The known open bug from iter_36 (CalendarView worker prev-day boundary) was NOT re-tested here — main agent should still address it.
